consultation_record.consultation_abstract: Abstract: Admitted for 'hematochezia >3 mos'. Admission Dx: 1. Rectal mass 2. Carotid stenosis 3. Lumbar disc herniation. CEA: 5.46 ng/mL, AFP: 1925.61 ng/mL. Colonoscopy: Rectal CA. Requesting advice for further treatment.
consultation_record.consultation_advice:
Reviewed history and labs, physical exam unremarkable.
Current Dx:
Rectal malignancy with secondary liver malignancy.
Recommendations:
1. Agree with current management.
2. AFP is significantly elevated without hepatitis history. Combined with CT/MRI, dx is rectal cancer with liver metastasis. Recommend Hepatobiliary Surgery consult to evaluate for synchronous resection or sequential ablation.
3. Thank you.

consultation_record.consultation_abstract: Abstract: Admitted for 'hematochezia >3 mos'. ... MRI Upper Abdomen (12-04): Abnormal signal near diaphragmatic dome, consistent with metastasis. Requesting advice for further treatment.
consultation_record.consultation_advice:
History as above.
MRI shows abnormal signal near diaphragmatic dome, consistent with liver metastasis.
Patient is scheduled for surgery. After evaluation, recommend staged resection of liver metastasis. Follow up with Hepatobiliary Surgery.

first_record.description: 40yo M admitted for 'hematochezia >3 mos'. PMH: Carotid stenosis (>10 yrs), Lumbar disc herniation (>10 yrs). Denies HTN, DM, CAD, hepatitis, TB. NKDA. PE: Abd flat, soft, NT/ND, no masses, HSM negative. DRE: Hard mass palpable approx. 3 cm from anal verge; fingertip cannot pass. Labs: Pending.
first_record.diagnostic_basis: 40yo M admitted for 'hematochezia >3 mos'. ... DRE: Hard mass palpable approx. 3 cm from anal verge; fingertip cannot pass.
first_record.differential_diagnosis: 1. Ulcerative Colitis: Can present with purulent/bloody stool and crampy pain. Colonoscopy can confirm. 2. Colonic Polyp: Can cause changes in bowel habits and hematochezia. Usually pedunculated, soft. Colonoscopy with biopsy helps differentiate.
first_record.plan: 1. General surgery routine care, Level II nursing, semi-liquid diet. 2. Complete labs and imaging. 3. Actively evaluate, consult relevant departments if needed; schedule elective surgery if no contraindications.

other_records.record_content: Admitted for 'hematochezia >3 mos'... Consulted Interventional Oncology. Current Dx: Rectal malignancy with liver metastasis. Advice: Recommend Hepatobiliary Surgery consult for synchronous/sequential treatment. Plan followed.
... Consulted Hepatobiliary Surgery. MRI shows liver metastasis near diaphragmatic dome. Advice: Recommend staged resection of liver metastasis. Plan followed.

Brief history... Pre-op Dx: Rectal malignancy. Indication: Clear diagnosis, surgery aimed at symptom palliation. No absolute contraindications. Planned: Laparoscopic radical rectal cancer resection under GA. Risks discussed, consent signed. Surgeon reviewed, indicated for surgery.

Surgery completed at 14:00. Pre-op Dx: Rectal mass. Laparoscopic ISR + Diverting Ileostomy performed. Pneumoperitoneum 12mmHg, Trendelenburg 30 deg. Tumor below peritoneal reflection. IMA/IMV divided. Toldt's space developed. Rectum mobilized to pelvic floor. Transanal extraction. Diverting loop ileostomy created. EBL 50ml, no transfusion. Specimen to pathology.

ward_records.content: Stable, clear sensorium. T 36.3, P 112, R 23, BP 137/105. CT: Pulmonary nodules, rectal mass, liver S8 metastasis. CEA 5.46, AFP 1925.61. Attending: Proceed with colonoscopy.
Day 3, stable. Colonoscopy: Rectal CA. Attending: Schedule surgery if no contraindications.
POD 1, stable, afebrile. Urine 900ml, Drain 450ml. Abd soft, NT/ND. Attending: Continue antibiotics, TPN, monitor.
POD 2, stable, afebrile. NPO. Urine 2450ml, Drain 15ml. PCT 0.176, CRP 62.6, WBC 13.79, Alb 32.2. Attending: Continue supportive care.
POD 3, stable, afebrile. NPO. Attending: Repeat labs, monitor.
POD 6, stable, liquid diet. CT: Liver S8 metastasis enlarged. Sigmoid wall thickening (inflammatory). Alb 29.9, WBC 10.37, PCT 0.073. Attending: Continue supportive care.
Stable, liquid diet. AFP 271.12. Attending: Monitor.
Stable, semi-liquid diet. Pathology: pT3N0Mx, moderately differentiated tubular adenocarcinoma, LVI+, MMR proficient. Margins negative. LN 0/25. Discharge approved.

enter_record.body_examination: T 36.3℃ P 112 bpm R 23 bpm BP 137/105 mmHg H 175 cm BW 85 kg. VTE risk: Low. NRS-2002: 6. Middle-aged male, normal development, moderate nutrition, clear sensorium, cooperative. Skin: no jaundice, petechiae, or bleeding. Lymph nodes: no palpable lymphadenopathy. HEENT: normal skull, hair distribution. No eyelid edema, conjunctival injection, or scleral icterus. Pupils equal, round, reactive to light and accommodation (PERRLA). Ears/nose unremarkable. Lips no cyanosis. Pharynx clear, tonsils normal. Neck: supple, no JVD, no carotid bruits, trachea midline, thyroid normal. Chest: symmetrical, clear to auscultation bilaterally (CTAB), no wheezes/rales. CV: regular rate and rhythm (RRR), no murmurs/rubs/gallops, PMI normal. Abd: flat, soft, NT/ND, no masses, HSM negative, Murphy's negative, no CVA tenderness, normoactive bowel sounds, shifting dullness negative. Ext: no deformities, no edema, DP pulses 2+ bilaterally. Neuro: DTRs 2+, abdominal reflexes normal, Babinski/Brudzinski negative.
enter_record.family: Parents alive; denies family history of genetic or infectious diseases.
enter_record.marriage: Married at appropriate age, harmonious relationship. 2 daughters, all healthy.
enter_record.past: PMH: Carotid artery stenosis (>10 yrs), Lumbar disc herniation (>10 yrs). Denies HTN, DM, CAD. Denies hepatitis, TB, or close contacts. Denies other surgeries, trauma, or transfusions. NKDA. Immunizations up to date.
enter_record.personal: Born locally, denies long-term residence elsewhere or epidemic areas. Smoker (13 yrs, 1 pack/day), occasional alcohol. Denies occupational exposures or high-risk sexual behavior.
enter_record.present: Intermittent hematochezia starting approx. 3 months ago. Bright red blood, occasionally with clots and mucus. No melena, fever, abdominal pain/distension, diarrhea, constipation, nausea, or vomiting. No urinary symptoms. Visited local hospital without specific treatment. Admitted via outpatient clinic for 'Rectal Space-Occupying Lesion'. Since onset, mental status and diet are fair, sleep is poor. Bowel movements as described, urination normal, no significant weight change.
enter_record.specialist_examination: Abd flat, no varices, no gastric/intestinal patterns or peristaltic waves. Soft, NT/ND, no masses, HSM negative, no CVA tenderness, shifting dullness (-), bowel sounds normal. DRE in knee-chest position: visual inspection unremarkable. DRE: Hard mass palpable approx. 3 cm from anal verge; fingertip cannot pass.

exit_record.enter_description: 40yo M admitted for 'hematochezia >3 mos'. PMH: Carotid stenosis, Lumbar disc herniation. DRE: Hard mass 3cm from anal verge.
exit_record.out_description: Stable, afebrile, no abdominal pain/distension. Semi-liquid diet tolerated. Abd soft, NT/ND.
exit_record.treatment: Admitted for workup. CT/MRI: Rectal mass, liver S8 metastasis, pulmonary nodules. CEA 5.46, AFP 1925.61. Colonoscopy/Biopsy: Rectal poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma. Underwent Laparoscopic ISR + Diverting Ileostomy on 12-06. Pathology: pT3N0Mx, moderately differentiated tubular adenocarcinoma, LVI+, MMR proficient. Post-op CT: Liver metastasis enlarged, sigmoid inflammatory thickening. Recovered well, discharged.

image_reports.findings: Liver: Abnormal signal near diaphragmatic dome (2.2x2.0cm), ring enhancement. Spleen: Accessory spleen (0.7cm).

image_reports.diagnosis:
Middle-lower rectal mass, consistent with malignancy (cT3cN1)
MRF: Positive
EMVI: Score 4
image_reports.findings: Circumferential thickening 58mm long, 18mm thick. Invades through muscularis propria into mesorectum (11mm). Distal margin 5mm below anorectal junction. 3 suspicious mesorectal lymph nodes (max 9mm). MRF <=1mm. EMVI positive.

Liver S8 metastasis (enlarged)

Sigmoid wall thickening (inflammatory)
image_reports.findings: Lungs: Nodules, fibrosis. Heart: Pericardial effusion. Liver: S8 metastasis 2.1cm (enlarged). Pelvis: Post-op changes, fluid/gas. Sigmoid: Inflammatory thickening.

Bilateral pulmonary nodules
Rectal mass, sigmoid thickening
Liver S8 metastasis
image_reports.findings: Lungs: Nodules. Liver: S8 metastasis 1.8cm. Rectum: Irregular thickening, narrowed lumen.

image_reports.diagnosis: Bilateral lower extremity deep and superficial veins: No DVT or venous insufficiency
image_reports.findings: Normal venous flow, no thrombosis, no reflux.

operations.process: GA, supine, prepped/draped, Foley placed. Veress needle, CO2 pneumoperitoneum (12mmHg). Trendelenburg 30 deg. Trocars placed. Exploration: no ascites, no peritoneal nodules. Tumor below peritoneal reflection. Decision: ISR + Diverting Ileostomy. IMA/IMV divided with Hem-o-lok. Toldt's space developed. Rectum mobilized to pelvic floor. Distal rectum transected 10cm above tumor. Transanal extraction. Proximal colon sutured to anal canal. Pelvic drain placed. Loop ileostomy created 30cm proximal to IC valve. Hemostasis confirmed. EBL 50ml.

pathologies.diagnosis:
(Rectum) Poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma.
IHC: CK20 (partial+), Villin (+), SATB2 (focal+), CK7 (-), Syn (focal+), INSM1 (focal+), AFP (focal+), SALL4 (focal+), Glypican-3 (focal+), HER2 (1+).

Tumor: Rectum, below peritoneal reflection. Size: 7x5cm, 1.5cm thick. Gross: Discoid elevated. Histo: Tubular adenocarcinoma with focal neuroendocrine expression. Grade: Moderately differentiated. Invasion: pT3. LVI: Focal vascular tumor thrombus. PNI: Negative. Tumor budding: Grade 2. Margins: Negative (prox 5cm, dist 0.8cm). LNs: 0/25 positive. pTNM: pT3N0Mx. IHC: HER2(1+), Syn(+, 5%), BRAF(-), INSM1(-), MMR proficient (MSH6+, MSH2+, MLH1+, PMS2+), CD34(-), D2-40(-).
pathologies.gross_description: Rectum 10.8cm long. Tumor 7x5cm, invading perirectal tissue. 25 LNs negative.
